items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he used to call me the "Fice" ... He would say "You're just like a little Fice; you cause all the trouble, you're always around jamming"

ctx.x: Right. So he would catch me every time, and he used to call me the "Fice" -- you know, he meant the little dog, you know -- the little Fice dog? He would say "You're just

like a little Fice; you cause all the trouble, you're always around jamming" -- but he never could stop me, because I wouldn't stop; you know, I was just kind of a revolutionary or something about it, because I was gonna play music, you know? And I wasn't gonna allow them to stop me.
